inlines.v: PAL'FREY, noun [Low Latin paraveredi, [plu of veredus, ] horses of a large size, used for carrying the baggage of an army.] 1. A horse used by noblemen and others for state, distinguished from a war horse. 2. A small horse fit for ladies.
